title: Part 3 — Conversation 1: a budget disagreement
instructionsVi: Nghe rồi trả lời 3 câu. Ở mục tiêu 650, câu hỏi bắt đầu hỏi về lý do và ý kiến, không chỉ hỏi sự việc.
promptEn: Listen to the conversation and answer questions 32 through 34.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Have you seen the quote for the new shelving? Nineteen thousand.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: That's well over what we set aside. What did we budget, twelve?

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Twelve. The difference is the installation — they won't sell the units without fitting them.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Could we buy from someone else and fit them ourselves?

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: We could, but our insurance won't cover racking that hasn't been professionally installed. I checked this morning.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Then the extra seven thousand isn't really optional. Let's put it to the finance committee rather than trying to cut corners.

questions.prompt: 32. What is the problem?

options.text: The supplier has gone out of business.

questions.explanationVi: Báo giá 19.000 so với ngân sách 12.000. Bảo hiểm là chi tiết phụ, không phải vấn đề chính.

questions.prompt: 33. Why can't they install the shelving themselves?

options.text: Nobody on the team is qualified.
Their insurance would not cover it.

questions.explanationVi: 'our insurance won't cover racking that hasn't been professionally installed'.

questions.prompt: 34. What do they decide to do?

options.text: Refer the extra cost to the finance committee

questions.explanationVi: 'Let's put it to the finance committee rather than trying to cut corners'.

title: Part 3 — Conversation 2: rescheduling an inspection
instructionsVi: Nghe rồi trả lời 3 câu. Có hai mốc thời gian và một trong hai bị thay đổi — bám vào lượt nói cuối.
promptEn: Listen to the conversation and answer questions 35 through 37.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: The health and safety inspection is booked for the tenth, isn't it?

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: It was. The inspector emailed yesterday — she's moved it to the seventeenth because of a clash.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: That's actually better. The new extraction system won't be commissioned until the fourteenth.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: That's what I thought. It would have been awkward to have her here while it was half installed.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Do we need to prepare anything?

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: The risk assessments and the training log. I'll pull those together, but I'll need the fire drill record from you — that's held on your side.

questions.prompt: 35. When will the inspection now take place?
questions.explanationVi: 'she's moved it to the seventeenth'. Ngày 10 là lịch cũ, ngày 14 là mốc lắp xong hệ thống hút.

questions.prompt: 36. Why does the man consider the change an improvement?

options.text: He will be away on the tenth.
The inspector charges less later in the month.
The new system will be finished by then.

questions.explanationVi: 'The new extraction system won't be commissioned until the fourteenth' — lùi sang ngày 17 thì hệ thống đã xong.

questions.prompt: 37. What does the woman ask the man to provide?
questions.explanationVi: 'I'll need the fire drill record from you'. Hai thứ kia bà ấy tự lo.

title: Part 3 — Conversation 3: a returning customer
instructionsVi: Nghe rồi trả lời 3 câu. Phân biệt điều khách YÊU CẦU với điều nhân viên thực sự làm được.
promptEn: Listen to the conversation and answer questions 38 through 40.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: I ordered a desk lamp online last week and it arrived with a cracked base. I'd like to exchange it.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: I'm sorry about that. Do you have the order number?

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: It's on my phone — here.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Thank you. I can see it. Unfortunately that model is out of stock and the next delivery isn't until the end of the month.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: I need it before then, really.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Then I'd suggest a refund rather than waiting. Or, if you like the design, there's a very similar model in the same range — it's eight pounds more, but I'll waive the difference given what happened.

questions.prompt: 38. Why has the woman come to the shop?

options.text: To ask about a delivery date

questions.explanationVi: 'it arrived with a cracked base. I'd like to exchange it'.

questions.prompt: 39. What is the problem with a direct exchange?

options.text: That model is out of stock.
The item was bought online, not in store.

questions.explanationVi: 'that model is out of stock and the next delivery isn't until the end of the month'.

questions.prompt: 40. What does the man offer?

options.text: Free delivery at the end of the month
A similar model at no extra cost
A discount on a future purchase

questions.explanationVi: 'it's eight pounds more, but I'll waive the difference given what happened'.

title: Part 3 — Conversation 4: three speakers, a recruitment decision
format: TOEIC Listening — Part 3 · Conversation 4, ba người nói (câu 41–43)
instructionsVi: Hội thoại BA người. Câu hỏi hỏi ý kiến của từng người, nên phải theo dõi ai nói gì.
promptEn: Listen to the conversation among three speakers and answer questions 41 through 43.

transcript.speaker: W1
transcript.text: So, two candidates left. Do we go with Okafor or Vasquez?

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Okafor, for me. Six years in the sector and she's managed a team this size before.

transcript.speaker: W2
transcript.text: I'd lean the other way, actually. Vasquez has less experience, but the way she handled the scenario question was the best I've seen in this round.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: That's a fair point. Though a scenario is one afternoon; six years is six years.

transcript.speaker: W2
transcript.text: Agreed. What tips it for me is that Vasquez asked what our biggest problem was, and nobody else did.

transcript.speaker: W1
transcript.text: Let's not decide today. I'd like to take up references for both before we commit — we've been caught out before.

questions.prompt: 41. Why does the man prefer Ms Okafor?

options.text: She answered the scenario question best.

questions.explanationVi: 'Six years in the sector and she's managed a team this size before'. (A) là lý do của người phụ nữ thứ hai.

questions.prompt: 42. What finally decides it for the second woman?

options.text: Vasquez asking about the company's biggest problem

questions.explanationVi: 'What tips it for me is that Vasquez asked what our biggest problem was, and nobody else did'.

questions.prompt: 43. What does the first woman propose?
questions.explanationVi: 'I'd like to take up references for both before we commit'.

title: Part 3 — Conversation 5: a software problem
instructionsVi: Nghe rồi trả lời 3 câu. Có một chi tiết nêu dưới dạng điều kiện — bỏ qua điều kiện là chọn sai.
promptEn: Listen to the conversation and answer questions 44 through 46.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: IT helpdesk, Sanjay speaking.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Hi. I can't open any of the shared spreadsheets this morning. It says I don't have permission.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Which folder are they in?

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Finance, then Monthly.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Ah. That folder was moved to the new server last night and permissions have to be reassigned individually. You're not the first to call.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: How long will that take? I've got a deadline at noon.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: I can do yours now, about ten minutes. But you'll need to sign out completely and back in — closing the window isn't enough, and that's what catches people out.

questions.prompt: 44. What is the woman's problem?
questions.explanationVi: 'I can't open any of the shared spreadsheets… It says I don't have permission'.

questions.prompt: 45. What caused the problem?

options.text: The folder was moved to a new server.

questions.explanationVi: 'That folder was moved to the new server last night and permissions have to be reassigned individually'.

questions.prompt: 46. What must the woman do after the fix?

options.text: Sign out completely and sign back in

questions.explanationVi: 'you'll need to sign out completely and back in — closing the window isn't enough'. Câu phủ định loại thẳng (B).

title: Part 3 — Conversation 6: planning an office move
instructionsVi: Nghe rồi trả lời 3 câu. Câu thứ hai hỏi HÀM Ý của một câu nói, không hỏi nghĩa đen.
promptEn: Listen to the conversation and answer questions 47 through 49.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: The removal company says they can do the whole move in one weekend.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: One weekend. For four floors.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: You don't think so?

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Not with the server room. That alone took two days last time, and we had twice the staff then.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: So what would you suggest?

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Move the server room the weekend before, on its own. Then the offices can go in one weekend and nobody's waiting on IT to finish.

questions.prompt: 47. What are the speakers discussing?

options.text: The timetable for an office move

questions.explanationVi: Cả đoạn bàn việc chuyển văn phòng mất bao lâu và chia thành mấy đợt.

questions.prompt: 48. What does the man mean when he says, 'One weekend. For four floors.'?

options.text: He is impressed by the speed.
He wants to know the cost.
He thinks four floors is too few.

questions.explanationVi: Câu lặp lại đầy hoài nghi, và người phụ nữ hiểu ngay nên hỏi 'You don't think so?'. Sau đó ông ta nêu lý do phòng máy chủ.

questions.prompt: 49. What does the man suggest?

options.text: Moving the server room a week earlier

questions.explanationVi: 'Move the server room the weekend before, on its own'.

title: Part 3 — Conversation 7: a supplier visit
instructionsVi: Nghe rồi trả lời 3 câu. Có một thông tin bị sửa lại giữa chừng và một yêu cầu chuẩn bị.
promptEn: Listen to the conversation and answer questions 50 through 52.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: The team from Northline are visiting on Wednesday. Four of them, I think.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Five, actually — they've added their quality manager since the last email.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Five. I'll update the visitor list. What time do they land?

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Half nine, so they'll be here around eleven allowing for traffic.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Should I arrange lunch?

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Please. And two of them are vegetarian — I'll forward the email so you have it in writing.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Right. I'll book the boardroom from eleven and order in rather than going out; it saves an hour.

questions.prompt: 50. How many visitors are expected?
questions.explanationVi: Người đàn ông nói bốn, người phụ nữ sửa: 'Five, actually'. Hai là số người ăn chay, mười một là giờ tới.

questions.prompt: 51. What will the woman send?
questions.explanationVi: 'two of them are vegetarian — I'll forward the email so you have it in writing'.

questions.prompt: 52. Why will the man order food in?

options.text: It is cheaper than a restaurant.

questions.explanationVi: 'order in rather than going out; it saves an hour'.
